messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Malayalam, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Malayalam line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
അഹ് എന്താണെന്ന് പറയാൻ എത്ര കഠിനമായ കാര്യമാണെന്ന് ഈ കാട്ടു കഠിനവും സാന്ദ്രവുമായ മരവനം ചിന്തയിൽ ഭയത്തെ പുതുക്കുന്നു!

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| # | Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase (Malayalam) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |---|-------------|-----------------------|----------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | 1 | Ahi | Interjection – exclamation of emotion | **അഹ്** | “Ah!” | OK | | 2 | quanto | Adverb intensifier “how” (degree) | **എത്ര** | “how” | OK | | 3 | a | Preposition / infinitive marker “to” | *(none)* | – | **MISSING** | | 4 | dir | Verb infinitive “tell” | **പറയാൻ** | “to tell” | OK | | 5 | qual | Interrogative adjective “what” | **എന്താണെന്ന്** | “what … is” | OK | | 6 | era | Verb imperfect “was” | *(none)* | – | **MISSING** | | 7 | è | Verb present “is” (copula) | **…മാണെന്ന്** (part of **കാര്യമാണെന്ന്**) | “is” | OK | | 8 | cosa | Noun “thing” | **കാര്യം** | “thing” | OK | | 9 | dura | Adjective “hard” | **കഠിനമായ** | “hard” | OK | |10| esta | Demonstrative adjective “this” | **ഈ** | “this” | OK | |11| selva | Noun “forest / wood” | **കാട്ടു** | “forest / wood” | OK | |12| selvaggia | Adjective “wild” | *(none)* | – | **MISSING** | |13| e (1st) | Coordinating conjunction “and” | **വും** (conj. suffix) | “and” | OK | |14| aspra | Adjective “rough” | **സാന്ദ്രവുമായ** | “dense” | **WRONG** (semantic mismatch) | |15| e (2nd) | Coordinating conjunction “and” | **വുമായ** (conj. suffix) | “and” | OK | |16| forte | Adjective “strong / dense” | **മരവനം** | “wood / forest” | **WRONG** (semantic mismatch) | |17| che | Relative pronoun “which” | *(none)* | – | **MISSING** | |18| nel | Contraction “in the” (preposition + article) | **ചിന്തയിൽ** | “in thought” | OK | |19| pensier | Noun “thought” | **ചിന്ത** | “thought” | OK | |20| rinova | Verb “renews” | **പുതുക്കുന്നു** | “renews” | OK | |21| la | Definite article “the” | *(none)* | – | **MISSING** | |22| paura | Noun “fear” | **ഭയത്തെ** | “the fear” | OK |
---
### Items Needing Attention **Missing translations** - `a` (infinitive marker) - `era` (past “was”) - `selvaggia` (“wild”) - `che` (relative pronoun “which”) - `la` (definite article “the”)
**Wrong/semantically inaccurate translations** - `aspra` rendered as **സാന്ദ്രവുമായ** (“dense”) – should convey “rough”. - `forte` rendered as **മരവനം** (“wood/forest”) – should convey “strong / dense”.
**Grammar issues** - None detected in the Malayalam output (agreement, case, etc., are acceptable).

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Malayalam script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Malayalam text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 4** - Original: അഹ് എന്താണെന്ന് പറയാൻ എത്ര കഠിനമായ കാര്യമാണെന്ന് - Issue: Missing pronoun “it” and past verb “was” (qual era). - Corrected: **അഹ് അത് എന്തായിരുന്നു എന്ന് പറയാൻ എത്ര കഠിനമായ കാര്യമാണെന്ന്**
- **Line 5** - Original: ഈ കാട്ടു കഠിനവും സാന്ദ്രവുമായ മരവനം - Issue: Missing adjective “wild” (selvaggia) and wrong noun “മരവനം”. - Corrected: **ഈ വന്യവും കഠിനവും സാന്ദ്രവുമായ കാട്ടു**
- **Line 6** - Original: ചിന്തയിൽ ഭയത്തെ പുതുക്കുന്നു! - Issue: Missing relative pronoun “which/it”. - Corrected: **അത് ചിന്തയിൽ ഭയത്തെ പുതുക്കുന്നു!**
```malayalam അഹ് അത് എന്തായിരുന്നു എന്ന് പറയാൻ എത്ര കഠിനമായ കാര്യമാണെന്ന് ഈ വന്യവും കഠിനവും സാന്ദ്രവുമായ കാട്ടു അത് ചിന്തയിൽ ഭയത്തെ പുതുക്കുന്നു! ```
